unit.why: R. Y. Weber's first-hand account (memorate) of a meeting in which the rebbe grasped and answered the gist of his request after only about twelve words, illustrating his quick, 'divine' intellect.
unit.boundary_note: the trailing heading 'משיחותיו ותורותיו הקדושים' belongs to the next section of teachings

stories.start_quote: כתב הרה״ג מוהר"י וועבער הנ"ל וז"ל
stories.end_quote: לא אמרתי לפניו בכערך שבעה תיבות
stories.summary_en: R. Y. Weber recounts that when he began to present a communal matter to the rebbe, after about twelve words the rebbe already stated the essence of the request, including what Weber had not yet said.

tags.why: The anecdote illustrates the rebbe's extraordinary quickness of mind and wise counsel.

quotes: תוכיות המבוקש מה שעדיין לא אמרתי לפניו
tags.why: The rebbe knows the unspoken content of the request, and his wisdom is called 'ענין אלקיי'.

quotes: שדברתי לפניו פ"א מענין אחד טובת הכלל
tags.why: A visitor brings a matter before the rebbe in an audience.

quotes: ומהירות שכלו הי׳ ענין אלקיי לא ישוער
tags.why: The tzaddik's counsel and intellect are presented as superhuman.

missing_concepts: the tzaddik's speed of intellect and wise counsel (עצה)
